decision.scope: The Kani verification lane's harness set under catherine-6g2: the arena landed on the build path, the build obligation is partitioned per family, and the walker families (check/soundness) stay in scope with their refined obligation.
decision.rationale: The lane extends rather than holds: its first verified results landed. (1) The arena (engine/store.rs Bounded<T,CAP>, array-backed under cfg(kani), Vec-backed otherwise) executed 0004's trigger: on the all-families build harness symex dropped 88.7 to 70.6 s, program steps 1146825 to 726468, VCCs after simplification 24066 to 11917, and the solver runs (17 properties solved individually) before the per-property encoding loop still exceeds 8 GB. (2) Partitioning the build obligation per family (design Decision 4) landed four PROVED harnesses at the standard — build_panic_freedom_equation 18.7 s/1.24 GB, _key 17.6 s/1.20 GB, _coproduct 18.7 s/1.29 GB, _pullback 36.5 s/1.89 GB (target/kani-timings.txt, logs target/part.log) — the lane's first proofs of the build walk's panic/overflow freedom. (3) The walker harnesses moved off the memory wall (~2.1-2.5 GB peak, was OOM above 24 GB) onto a solve-time wall: their remaining heap machinery (collect/extend/iterator adapters over the violated and findings vectors) still exceeds the 300 s wall. (4) The lane's first counterexample landed (check_coproduct_panic_freedom) and is attributed per Decision 5 to unwinding assertions on allocator-model loops in dangling_findings' violated collect/any chain (slice::Iter::any and Vec::extend_desugared at the unwind cap, same_allocation, usize::to_isize) — an artifact of the walker's heap machinery, not kernel logic; the machinery is what the walker arena removes. Revisit triggers, replacing 0004's: (1) the walker arena — bounded temporaries in engine/families.rs, engine/families/pullback.rs, soundness.rs (violated, findings out, key groups, coproduct images, fibers); (2) harness completion per family, then the all-families spaces' disposition re-read against the walker-arena formula; (3) budget revision only via the Decision 6 stop gate with a profile showing encoding inside the cap and solve dominating. Nothing is weakened: the counterexample is recorded as attributed, the all-families spaces stay declared with dispositions, and the parsed kernel remains byte-identical and fully green.
holes_found: the walker families' panic-freedom and witness-soundness claims (check_* and soundness_* harnesses) cannot be stated as completed proofs within the lane standard until the walker arena lands; they are recorded obligations, not theorems
the all-families build space cannot be discharged within the standard; its claim is carried by the four per-family build proofs
decision.fixture_only_comparison: The fixture corpus and contract suite pin the parsed surface byte-identically but never execute the engine's symbolic space; the four proved harnesses add executed verification of the build walk's panic/overflow freedom over every family's declared space — the lane's first assurance gain over fixtures. The undetermined walker harnesses still add zero assurance beyond fixtures. Cost: four proved runs (~90 s wall total), ten bounded timeouts (~50 min), one attributed counterexample run.
